messages:
amanda: Heads-up team: starting tenant billing schema change prep in 20m. Plan: pin api-service to v3.1.2 for the window, create new column invoice_tax_code, staggered backfill. Quiet window 01:00-03:00 UTC.

matt: ACK. Which table and rough rows? Any locks expected?

amanda: invoices_payments, ~12M rows. ALTER is fast (ADD COLUMN), backfill will be batched updates. Expect short row-level locks, no long exclusive table locks.

leila: Backfill config proposal: BACKFILL_BATCH_ROWS=5000, BACKFILL_SLEEP_MS=250, MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS=12. That should keep p99 below our SLO.

jonas: Suggest read routing: pin replicas for reads during backfill. If we hit >1s lock_wait, pause and route reads fully to replicas.

amanda: Adding a traffic dampen rule: 80% reads -> replicas, 20% fallback to primary. Will commit to rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @amanda: migration-job v2026-06-15 queued. Canary on 3 workers starting now with sample=10k rows.

matt: Canary good -> what's rollback/escalation path?

amanda: Escalation plan: 1) Pause backfill via deploy-bot hold. 2) Revert traffic routing. 3) If data integrity issues -> restore from snapshot (pre-migration) and open incident.

paul: Runbook snippet to validate null-safety after each batch:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices_payments WHERE invoice_tax_code IS NULL AND status != 'cancelled';
```
Run this post-batch.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor lock_monitor and pg_stat_activity. If lock_waits >50ms sustained for 2m, we'll hit the holdpoint and pause. Ping #incidents if that happens.

leila: Adding auto-pause: deploy-bot flag --auto-pause-on-error with threshold 3 consecutive batch errors.

deploy-bot: canary results: 10k rows processed, 0 constraint violations, avg batch latency 180ms, peak_lock_wait 22ms. Canary SUCCESS.

amanda: Kicking off rollout to 25% workers now. Posting release note: "billing migration: add invoice_tax_code (backfilled). Pin api-service v3.1.2 during migration window."

matt: Add snapshot info + revert command to release note please.

amanda: Added: "snapshot: rds-prod-snap-2026-06-15-0100; revert: rds-restore --from rds-prod-snap-2026-06-15-0100"

jonas: Gate long queries: any session >5m auto-notify and after warning auto-kill. Upload logs to s3://redwood-migration-logs/1769464000/

amanda: Affirmative. Proceeding with staged rollout. Will post final status when done. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout at 25% -> progressing. Watch for holds in this thread.

amanda: Update @everyone: at 25% -> no errors, lock_wait median 18ms. Proceeding to 50% in 10m.

sre-oncall: Observing database: small spike in lock_waits during a 10s window, stayed below threshold. continuing to monitor.

paul: Reminder: add migration note to release notes page and tag the DB SME for post-mortem if any unexpected latency regressions show up.

amanda: Done. tagging for post-mortem only if we hit the holdpoint. Final status will follow after 100% rollout.
